answer_units.text: **Likely causes first, then UI checks:**

answer_units.label: addresses_question
answer_units.text: **Exam not published** — Unpublished or archived exams cannot be accessed.

answer_units.label: addresses_question
answer_units.text: Confirm the exam status is **Published** in the Exams workspace.

answer_units.label: addresses_question
answer_units.text: **Link window expired** — Check the **available_until** date on the **Links** tab.

answer_units.label: addresses_question
answer_units.text: If the window has passed, students will be blocked.

answer_units.label: addresses_question
answer_units.text: **Verification form required** — If the exam has a verification schema, students must complete all required fields before starting.

answer_units.label: addresses_question
answer_units.text: Review **Verification schema** settings.

answer_units.label: addresses_question
answer_units.text: **Max attempts exhausted** — If **max attempts** is set and the student has used all allowed attempts, they cannot start again.

answer_units.label: addresses_question
answer_units.text: **UI checks (in order):**

answer_units.label: addresses_question
answer_units.text: - Open the **Exams** workspace → select the exam → verify the **Publish** action is active and all questions are approved on the **Questions** tab.

answer_units.label: addresses_question
answer_units.text: - Go to the **Links** tab and confirm the link is active and the **available_until** date has not passed.

answer_units.label: addresses_question
answer_units.text: - If verification is enabled, open the **Verification** tab and ensure the schema does not block entry.

answer_units.label: addresses_question
answer_units.text: - Check **Attempts** settings under the exam configuration to see if the student has reached the limit.

answer_units.label: addresses_question
answer_units.text: If none of these resolve the issue, contact support with the exam ID and student details.

statements.label: addresses_question

statements.statement: - If verification is enabled, open the Verification tab and ensure the schema does not block entry.
statements.label: addresses_question

statements.statement: - Check Attempts settings under the exam configuration to see if the student has reached the limit.
statements.label: addresses_question
